_comment: Google Gemini CLI - MCP server config for the UE4.27 bridge.
Copy the mcpServers block into ~/.gemini/settings.json (user-wide) or
.gemini/settings.json in a project. Gemini does not read .mcp.json.
Paths are absolute because Gemini launches the server with its own cwd.
UE_ENGINE_ROOT and MCP_UNREAL_PROJECT_ROOT are deliberately absent: the
server reads them from the gitignored bridge.local.json in the repository
root, written by Scripts/setup-unreal-project.ps1. Setting either here
unreal-api runs through the launcher so it uses the pinned virtual
environment. 'uvx unreal-api-mcp' resolves mcp 2.0.0, which dropped
Build the server first: npm run build
Remove this _comment key if your Gemini version rejects unknown fields.
